Maverick Power is hiring a Junior Software Developer to build and maintain software supporting its internal operations and customer-facing products. The role works with developers and cross-functional teams on full-stack development, cloud applications, APIs, databases, automation, and AI-powered software.

Responsibilities
Build user-facing features with React and Next.js
Write clean, type-safe code in TypeScript across frontend and backend
Implement APIs and server-side logic (e.g., Next.js route handlers/serverless)
Model, query, and migrate data using Prisma
Collaborate on database design and performance improvements
Work with AWS services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, and managed databases (as needed)
Fix bugs, improve performance, and enhance accessibility and UX quality
Contribute tests and help maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, standups, and demos
Document technical decisions and communicate progress clearly with the team

Basic experience with React (components, state, effects) and interest in Next.js patterns (routing, SSR/SSG, server components)
Understanding of API concepts (REST, JSON), and comfort learning databases/ORMs (Prisma)
Strong communication, curiosity, and willingness to ask questions early
Preferred
Personal projects with Next.js and TypeScript
Any experience with Prisma and relational database
Exposure to AWS (even via coursework or tutorials)
Experience with testing (Jest/Vitest/Playwright/Cypress)
Familiarity with authentication/authorization basics and web security fundamentals
